svg.title: NL Shell — Final Locked Architecture
svg.desc: Final pipeline with behavioral memory feedback to LLM #1, proactive safety in LLM #2, and error/retry loop from execution back to shell synthesis.

g.onclick: sendPrompt('Tell me more about the Typer CLI input layer')
sendPrompt('How does behavioral memory context enrich LLM #1 intent classification?')
sendPrompt('What does the structured JSON action schema contain?')
sendPrompt('How does the validation and policy engine work?')
sendPrompt('How does proactive safety work inside LLM #2 shell synthesis?')
g.text: + proactive safety rules in system prompt

sendPrompt('How does the static dangerous pattern detector work?')
sendPrompt('How does the risk evaluation engine score commands?')

sendPrompt('What does the user confirmation flow look like for medium risk?')
sendPrompt('How are high risk commands blocked or escalated?')
sendPrompt('What gets logged when a high risk command is blocked?')
sendPrompt('How is the Docker sandboxed runtime configured?')
sendPrompt('What shells are supported for execution?')
sendPrompt('How are stdout, stderr and exit codes handled?')
sendPrompt('What metrics does the observability layer track?')
sendPrompt('What schema does the storage layer use?')
g.text: Input · schema · command · risk score · result · retry count
